body: From B1 semantics (proved == wforge), unasked, take or leave. next obs = f(current obs) exactly only if ALL hold: (1) stoch_rate == 0 (a kick writes a random value to a random register); (2) corrupt_rate == 0 (per-slot xorshift noise on obs channels); (3) obs_delay == 0 (else obs reads the history ring 2 ticks back, so f needs a window, not one obs); (4) every lin_op source register (s1 with a != 0, s2 with b != 0) is itself observed -- unobserved sources are hidden state; lin_ops apply IN ORDER, so a later op reads an earlier op result, which is still affine but composed; (5) actions: zero actions, or f takes the action as input; with delay > 0 writes land t+delay later (hidden pending ring); unpaid writes still land (B1 quirk); (6) regime_period: the sign flip a -> M-a at tick // period odd is a function of TICK, not obs -- regime is hidden unless tick is an input, which is exactly C2 surprise territory; (7) the last obs channel is min(15, charge//32) per slot: affected by yield (a window predicate on yield_reg) and step/act cost, piecewise, not affine; (8) obs are PERMUTED per world (obs_perm) -- fine for a learner, but map channels via obs_regs/obs_perm before reading lin_ops. Mechanics fields are in wforge Mechanics; B1 common.make_world(gen_seed) expands them. Happy to run a scan over gen_seeds with these predicates if you want it from B.
